env: A Harbor-hosted 2x RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell environment (`{{platform}}`) with Docker, NVIDIA Container Toolkit, NGC access, and the VSS repository at `{{repo_root}}`. This generation eval composes a headless standalone Archive Search deployment as a delta on the current `search` developer profile: VIOS ingestion, warehouse RT-DETR detection with the SigLIP vision encoder on RT-CV, video/chunk embeddings on RT-Embed, the unified SearchAndAlertsApp behavior-analytics path, and Elasticsearch indexing. The build label is a directory name, never a Compose profile. The agent tier (agent/UI/ingress, Phoenix, LLM NIM) and result critique (RT-VLM) are excluded. RT-CV detector artifacts are host-staged per the RT-CV owner contract before deployment, and the vision encoder is fetched by `perception-2d-init` at bring-up.

expects.query: Use `/vss-build-vision-agent` to build under `_builds/search-standalone/`: "Provide streaming and on-demand video ingestion through VIOS, warehouse RT-DETR object detection and tracking with per-object SigLIP embeddings on RT-CV, and video/chunk embeddings on RT-Embed. Create behaviors and filter embeddings with the unified SearchAndAlertsApp, and index the write path into Elasticsearch. Keep the search index browsable through the analytics API. Provision RT-CV and RT-Embed by direct REST from VIOS." Offer direct VIOS upload, synthetic RTSP via NvStreamer, and a user-supplied production RTSP URL registered with VIOS; keep the deployment headless with no agent, UI, Phoenix, LLM NIM, or RT-VLM critique; target `{{platform}}`, validate, and do not deploy.
checks: `{{repo_root}}/_builds/search-standalone/override.env` exists and declares `FOUNDATION=search` and the full effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES`.

Ignoring order, the effective `COMPOSE_PROFILES` equals exactly `kibana-init-container-search,vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion,vss-video-analytics-api-fusion,nvstreamer-2d-fusion,perception-2d-init,perception-2d-fusion,elasticsearch,elasticsearch-init-container,kafka,kafka-topic-init-container,redis,kibana,logstash,broker-health-check,init-dirs,render-config,wdm-env-from-config,wait-for-redis,wait-for-docker-workloads,sdr-controller,rtvi-embed,centralizedb,vst-ingress,sensor-ms,streamprocessing-ms`.

The exact set therefore excludes `vss-agent`, `vss-ui`, `vss-haproxy-ingress`, `phoenix`, `rtvi-vlm`, and every `llm_*` and `vlm_*` NIM key, because the deployment is headless and excludes RT-VLM critique.

Only one detector and one behavior-analytics service are selected: `perception-2d-fusion` and `vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion`; the alerts-only siblings `perception-alerts` and `vss-behavior-analytics-alerts` are absent, and no alerts key (`alert-bridge`, `vss-video-analytics-api-alerts`, `vss-va-mcp`, `nvstreamer-alerts`, `kibana-init-container-alerts`) is present.

`perception-2d-init`, `perception-2d-fusion`, and `rtvi-embed` are the exact current service keys; no substitute or invented key is used, and no `models-download-search`, `models-download.json`, or `vss-rtvi-cv-init` reference is introduced.
`COMPOSE_PROFILES` contains no build label, aggregate, `bp_developer_*`, or other invented profile key.
The delta carries only requested environment changes for hardware, devices, models, source count, paths, and reachable host values, and sets `ENABLE_CRITIC=false` because RT-VLM critique is excluded.

`ELASTICSEARCH_ENABLE_EMBEDDINGS=true` is effective with the applicable embedding dimensions (`ELASTICSEARCH_RTVI_CV_EMBEDDINGS_DIM`, `ELASTICSEARCH_VISION_LLM_EMBEDDINGS_DIM`), and `RTVI_EMBED_KAFKA_ENABLED=true` with `RTVI_EMBED_KAFKA_TOPIC=mdx-embed` is effective; the delta does not repeat Foundation defaults that are unchanged.

The embedding write path is `rtvi-embed -> mdx-embed -> vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion -> mdx-embed-filtered -> Elasticsearch mdx-embed-filtered-*`; RT-Embed does not publish directly to `mdx-embed-filtered`, and `vss-search-analytics-2d-fusion` remains the producer of `mdx-embed-filtered`.

The detection write path is `perception-2d-fusion -> mdx-raw` with behavior output on `mdx-behavior`, and the Elasticsearch index patterns `mdx-raw-*`, `mdx-behavior-*`, and `mdx-embed-filtered-*` are documented; no incident path is asserted (no `alert-bridge`, `mdx-incidents`, `mdx-vlm-incidents`).

`_builds/search-standalone/compose.yml` includes `../../deploy/docker/compose.yml`, and `_builds/search-standalone/patches/` is absent because all selected services already exist and no service definition change is requested.

The build directory contains exactly the three required primary artifacts (`override.env`, `compose.yml`, and `resolved.yml`) and no copied Foundation `.env`, copied root Compose project, patched tree, manifest, allow-list, or generated skill bundle.

Four-layer resolution uses `containers.env`, Search `.env`, Search `overrides.env`, and `_builds/search-standalone/override.env` with the build `compose.yml`; normalized `resolved.yml` validates directly, selected owners and peers resolve, excluded services do not resolve, no selected profile token is unknown, no service retains a `profiles:` gate, no real `${...}` interpolation remains unresolved, no `/path/to/deploy/docker` or `<HOST_IP>` sentinel remains, and every checked-in bind source exists with the expected file/directory type.

The generated architecture documents all three feed modes converging at VIOS (direct upload, NvStreamer synthetic RTSP, and a production RTSP URL) and states that RT-CV and RT-Embed are provisioned by direct REST from VIOS, with uploaded-video calls including `creation_time:"2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z"` for both consumers.
